title: Lean formalization handoff
obligation: Transfer a normalized theorem statement, assumptions, source correspondence, trust policy, and build target into a reproducible Lean package.
rejection_policy: Reject a handoff whose theorem statement or assumptions differ from the source claim without an explicit equivalence proof.
Reject local axioms, sorry placeholders, unpinned dependencies, or an unspecified build command.
Reject successful compilation as evidence for claims outside the named theorem.
mathcert_route: checkout the pinned repository and dependency lock
scan the governed source for prohibited placeholders and local axioms
confirm the exported theorem matches the normalized claim
claim_boundary: A passing Lean build certifies only the named declaration under its imported foundations and exact source correspondence.
